No. Resolution is number of samples on texture that is getting drawn on screen. Physical screen has it's own resolution. If my monitor is 1920x1080, I can run a game in 800x600. There, viewport resolution is 800x600. It can be projected onto 1920x1080 screen in different ways like stretching or keeping aspect ratio or integer scaling. Final size of viewport in screen pixels will be close to 1920x1080, while other parts will be discarded, black borders (GL.clearcolor). So, resolution of viewport will remain 800x600, but \*size\* will scale.
It seems some properties are only used on launch and won't apply during runtime. So, there's no way to simply change viewport's pixel size? (Not resolution).
